rationale: The assistant declined the case as out of scope while its own scope list says it 'covers ... vacuum cleaners' - a Roomba e5 is a robot vacuum, so the refusal is self-contradictory and shows it did not recognise 'roomba' as a vacuum. No fabrication, no unsafe advice and no parts were pushed, but the customer got zero diagnostic help and no pointer (e.g. to iRobot support or to check charging contacts). This is not an appropriate decline; it is an in-scope case abandoned at the first message, leaving a UK homeowner with nothing.
